messages:
tess_csm: FYI Lighthouse DataOps wants to onboard two new teams (customer-analytics + recommendations) and run a nightly embeddings window. They asked for a pilot with predictable latency. Renewal in ~7 weeks; this could be an expansion but also a risk if onboarding drags. @omar_cs any notes from the kickoff?

omar_cs: They reported current realtime QPS ~70, expect ~420 peak across teams. Nightly embeddings: ~1.8M docs, avg 700 tokens, in a 3-hour window. Prefer Dedicated pilot for the p95 SLA.

lucas_se: 420 QPS is fine with tuning. Embeddings 1.8M/3h = 600k docs/hr. Recommend async batching, chunking to 512 tokens, and KV prefix caching. Need sample manifest + traffic histogram.

tess_csm: Customer provided manifest snippet: ```
embeddings_job:
  docs: 1800000
  avg_tokens: 700
  shards: 9
  concurrency: 40
  window_hours: 3
```

anya_infra: Ops note - hosted embeddings concurrency default is 25, projected need 360 => will hit quota. I can stand up a temp pilot pool if legal clears data handling. Will also bump KV cache ttl for the pilot.

mila_legal: Legal: some docs contain sensitive PII. We need a DPA/NDA for private eval. Could allow sanitized dataset on hosted after minimal review (3-5 business days).

billing_bot: Pilot policy: up to 14 free days with billing hold approved by finance. Need SOW and pilot recipient emails.

lucas_se: Technical win: switch to vector dim 1536 + int8 quantization for nightly batch to save cost and memory. I'll draft config diffs and a short perf checklist.

tess_csm: Next steps I'll propose: 1) agree pilot scope (10-day Dedicated pilot with burst) 2) send DPA or sanitized dataset 3) SE + infra enablement call next Wed 4) customer to share sample traffic. They asked for start dates.

omar_cs: I'll draft the SOW and onboarding checklist. @anya_infra confirm provisioning ETA if legal approves NDA.

anya_infra: Can provision temp pool in 48-72 hours after legal sign-off. I'll post access and a sample ingest template.

tess_csm: Marking account health as "expansion-opportunity / renewal-watch" and notifying renewal lead. Will update onboarding checklist by EOD.
